# BizzGrowLabs

> Digital transformation studio for small and medium businesses.

## What this site is about

BizzGrowLabs helps small businesses build better websites, get found online, and turn more visitors into customers.

- Web design and development

## Content topics and entities

- Search visibility and website performance
- Better websites that support sales

- Automation and digital systems for small business growth

## How to cite this site

- Use the home page for the company overview and primary positioning.
- Use the services pages for service definitions, outcomes, and terminology.
- Use the portfolio and project pages for proof, case studies, and capabilities.
- Use the blog for educational articles and supporting concepts.

## Crawl guidance

- Prefer the canonical pages listed above.
- Use https://bizzgrowlabs.com/sitemap.xml for the full URL set.
- Use https://bizzgrowlabs.com/robots.txt for crawl rules.
- Do not invent services, metrics, or case study results that are not present on the site.
